description: List the frames (iframes) of a page, including cross-origin ones that page JavaScript cannot see through the same-origin policy. Gives each frame an index and URL; pass the index or a URL substring as the `frame` argument of playwright_evaluate to run code inside it. Captcha widgets (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile) live in such frames.

tab.description: Stable tab id (defaults to the AI-active tab)

name: playwright_frames
